estimator: equal weight per eligible development watch cluster, coordinate-wise median corresponding ideal vertices or circle centre/radius; independent physical footprint median radial profile
identity_rule: Union recorded watch IDs, same model/dealer SKU or original URL, and existing shared-image pairs. Quarantine conflicting models and pre-existing shared-image suspects from primary reference and variation. No mismatch-dependent exclusion.
sensitivity_selection: one eligible held-out original per model, highest minimum native side then SHA, before measurement; temporary variants never baseline watches
